# Demand map (test fixture)

A minimal stand-in for an operator's demand-map research document, in the shape the
tool-opportunity detector parses: a ranked table of free-tool opportunities, plus an
appendix of the evidenced query formulations behind them.

## Ranked free-tool opportunities

| # | tool | audience | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | freelance rate calculator | Freelancer | Ranked tools exist for this query and none come from an invoicing vendor. |
| 2 | project cost/budget calculator | Buyer | Buyers search for budget ranges before they search for vendors. |
| 3 | client brief generator | Buyer | Brief-writing is the step before hiring, and nothing owns the query. |
| 4 | invoice due-date calculator | Freelancer | Payment-terms arithmetic is a recurring, answerable question. |
| 5 | rate-card generator | Freelancer | The output artifact freelancers ask for once they know their rate. |
